stories.title: Williams' 26, late free throws lift Valkyries past Dream in Game 1
stories.summary: The Valkyries held off the Dream 68-64 in Game 1 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Eagles star QB Hurts placed on IR, expected to be out indefinitely
stories.summary: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia after Stockton's fumble dooms Bulldogs
stories.summary: Auburn, led by QB Byrum Brown's dominant running game, upset No. 1 Georgia after taking advantage of a key fumble by Gunner Stockton with 58 seconds left.

stories.title: Ohio State survives Indiana on Marsh's fourth-down misstep
stories.summary: Ohio State survived what appeared to be the go-ahead score when Nick Marsh's left foot was ruled to be out of bounds as the Buckeyes beat Indiana 19-15 on Saturday.

stories.title: Durant, Ishbia go back and forth over framing of Suns tenure
stories.summary: Kevin Durant fired back at Suns owner Mat Ishbia on social media for framing Phoenix's acquisition of Durant as a mistake.
